# idle-code-baseline.txt is machine-written by the no-idle-code gate.
# Read the gate docs before editing this file.
# Idle public items, recorded so the gate can ratchet. The gate fails when an
# item not on the baseline becomes idle. The baseline only shrinks: do not add
# a line to excuse new idle code.
#
